lines.en: label dormwarssix3:
scene rocketshadowlegends
HI AGAIN! STILL HERE!
lines.zh: 又见面了！我还在！

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori1
: F...Food! What...does it mean?
lines.zh: : 食……食物！这……是什么意思？

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori2
: What is your response?!
lines.zh: : 你们的回答是什么？！

lines.en: : Wait, this isn’t actually a trivia contest, is it? I thought Ayane and Io were doing that one?
lines.zh: : 等等，这其实不是问答比赛吧？我以为 Ayane 和 Io 负责那个？

lines.en: : The question was rhetorical! And you have failed!
lines.zh: : 那是个反问句！而你答错了！

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori3
: How did I get a rhetorical question wrong?!
lines.zh: : 我怎么会把一个反问句答错？！

lines.en: : Food is...the building block of...all humanity! It is...the powerhouse of...the cell!
lines.zh: : 食物是……全人类的……基石！它是……细胞的……能量工厂！

lines.en: : That’s supposed to be mitochondria!
lines.zh: : 那是线粒体的台词吧！

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori4
: Just let her read her notes, Noriko! Kaori wanted to prepare a speech before the contest when she found out it was going to be televised. She’ll get to the rules soon enough, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 让她照着稿子念吧，Noriko！Kaori 一听说比赛要电视转播，就想赛前准备一段演讲。我敢肯定她很快就会讲到规则的。

lines.en: : Which brings us...to the rules!
lines.zh: : 那么就……来说说规则！

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 看吧？

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori5
: Two girls...two human hearts. And what better to warm the human heart than...food?
lines.zh: : 两个女孩……两颗人类的心。而有什么比……食物，更能温暖人心呢？

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori6

: Welcome to the Route 69 Diner! My name is Kaori Kadowaki and I am the greatest waitress in all of Kumon-mi! But you may refer to me as the Queen of Spiders, the Greatest Waitress in All of Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 69 号公路餐厅！我叫 Kaori Kadowaki，是 Kumon-mi 最伟大的服务员！不过你们也可以叫我蜘蛛女王，Kumon-mi 最伟大的服务员！

lines.en: : We’re not actually at the rules yet, are we?
lines.zh: : 我们其实还没讲到规则，是吧？

lines.en: : As the new owner of this food and beverage establishment, I have paused all sales for the day to assist in this War of the Dorms! Please help yourself to my eggs!
lines.zh: : 作为这家餐饮机构的新任老板，我今天暂停了所有营业，来协助这场宿舍大战！请随便享用我的蛋！

lines.en: : Girl.
lines.zh: : 女孩。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori7

: Yes! Girl! {i}Two{/i} girls! Who will have one hour to prepare an...assortment of dishes that will be judged by...myself and my daughterbug! And perhaps a surprise third guest who...lives inside of me!
lines.zh: : 没错！女孩！{i}两个{/i}女孩！你们将有一个小时来准备……一系列菜肴，评审是……我和我的女儿虫！也许还有一位惊喜的第三位嘉宾，她……住在我体内！

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori8
: Do you have relations with the cotton candy girl?
lines.zh: : 你跟那个棉花糖女孩有关系吗？

lines.en: : Are you...talking about my sister? And also, do you mean a {i}relationship?{/i} Because I don’t want to accidentally give you the wrong idea.
lines.zh: : 你……是在说我姐姐吗？还有，你是指{i}恋爱关系{/i}吗？因为我可不想不小心让你误会。

lines.en: : She is currently mad at me for engaging in sexual intercourse with who she says is her manfriend.
lines.zh: : 她现在正在生我的气，因为我和她口中的男朋友发生了性关系。

lines.en: : Oh hey, me too.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我也是。

lines.en: : Does this mean I should erase her name from my friendship journal? I do not know the rules of adultery.
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着我该把她的名字从我的友谊日记里划掉？我不懂通奸的规则。

lines.en: : Uhh...K...Kaori? Maybe just...get back to the rules, please?
lines.zh: : 呃……K……Kaori？能不能……先回到规则上，拜托？

lines.en: : Sorry, we can talk more about this later. You need to finish telling us how this contest works before Uta gets worked up and sneaks away to the bathroom for an extended period of time.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，这个我们可以以后再聊。你得先把比赛规则讲完，免得 Uta 激动起来，溜进浴室一待就是好长时间。

lines.en: : Who do you think I am?! Sana?! Kirin?! Rin?! Molly?! Nodoka?! Sana?!
lines.zh: : 你把我当成谁了？！Sana？！Kirin？！Rin？！Molly？！Nodoka？！Sana？！

lines.en: : Objection. If I wanted to pleasure myself in public, I would. I gain nothing from hiding away in a bathroom.
lines.zh: : 反对。如果我想在公共场合取悦自己，我早就做了。躲在浴室里我什么好处也得不到。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori9
: A-As I was saying...the rules are simple! You have...sixty minutes to complete an assortment of dishes and...whoever’s food is...the foodiest will...receive a point of war.
lines.zh: : 我……我刚才说到……规则很简单！你们有……六十分钟来完成一系列菜肴，而……谁的食物最……最「食物」，将……获得一分战功。

lines.en: : Make the foodiest food. Got it.
lines.zh: : 做出最「食物」的食物。明白了。

lines.en: : Girl.
lines.zh: : 女孩。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori10
: Chika, are you sure you can handle this? I’m not really confident in you working with knives and flames at the moment.
lines.zh: : Chika，你确定你能行吗？我现在真不太放心你同时用刀和火。

lines.en: : And if you’re only like this because you’re worried my sister could show up at any moment, I could tell her to wait until later to-
lines.zh: : 如果你这副样子只是因为担心我姐姐随时可能出现，我可以让她等到以后再——

lines.en: : Interfere with my goals and it will be you who is cooked, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 敢妨碍我的目标，被煮的就是你了，Noriko。

lines.en: : Like...as in defeated?
lines.zh: : 比如……被击败的意思？

lines.en: : No. I will chop you into pieces and grill your perfect body over an open flame.
lines.zh: : 不。我会把你切成块，在明火上烤了你那完美的身体。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori11
: Aww, perfect? Really? Thank you!
lines.zh: : 哇，完美？真的吗？谢谢你！

lines.en: : You know, a lot of people say that being a vegetarian is unhealthy when, in all actuality-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，很多人说吃素不健康，可实际上——

lines.en: : Go.
lines.zh: : 走开。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori12
: What, now?
lines.zh: : 什么，现在？

lines.en: : Yes! The contest has begun!
lines.zh: : 是的！比赛开始了！

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori13
: I brought my own knife.
lines.zh: : 我自己带了刀。

lines.en: : So we can just use whatever’s behind us? There’s no cap on ingredients or anything?
lines.zh: : 那我们只要用身后的这些东西就行？食材什么的没有上限？

lines.en: : There is a larger box of cold that you may walk into in the backwards room. The foods there are bigger and closer to decay.
lines.zh: : 后面那间屋子里有一个更大的冷藏箱，你可以走进去。那里的食材更大，也更接近腐烂。

lines.en: : Yeah, just these ingredients should be fine. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就用这些食材应该没问题。谢了。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori14
: Uhh...Chika? I know you’re, like...really excited about meeting Niki or whatever. And I know you’re probably also mad at me right now after you tried feeding me a dead animal at the maid cafe-
lines.zh: : 呃……Chika？我知道你……大概非常期待见到 Niki 还是什么的。我也知道你现在可能在生我的气，因为你在女仆咖啡厅试图喂我吃一只死动物——

lines.en: : Wait, she did what?
lines.zh: : 等等，她干了什么？

lines.en: : But I’m also, like, really worried about you going crazy and maybe hurting Noriko or yourself or whatever and I’d appreciate it if you’d put the knife down.
lines.zh: : 但我也……真的很担心你会发疯，说不定会伤到 Noriko 或者你自己什么的，所以如果你能把刀放下，我会很感激。

lines.en: : I have to make a delicious meal. You need a knife to make a delicious meal.
lines.zh: : 我必须做出一顿美味的饭。要做美味的饭就得用刀。

lines.en: : Then can I maybe {i}help{/i} you or something? Kaori skipped a lot of the rules but I checked them out on the Dorm Wars website and it says you’re allowed a sous chef. And I’ve technically done this before, so-
lines.zh: : 那我能不能{i}帮{/i}你一下什么的？Kaori 跳过了很多规则，但我在宿舍大战的网站上查过，上面说你可以有一个副厨。而且我严格来说以前做过这个，所以——

lines.en: : Is your name Sue?
lines.zh: : 你叫 Sue 吗？

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori15
: Uh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : I didn’t think so. Now, get out of my house and stop being so cute. I need to focus so I can impress the queen with my {b}FOOD.{/b}
lines.zh: : 我想也不是。现在，滚出我家，别再这么可爱了。我需要专心，才能用我的{b}食物{/b}打动女王。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori16
: {i}Cutting{/i} away from Chika for a second, pun intended, it looks like Noriko brought her own knife as well! Though, I’m not sure it’s quite up to code...
lines.zh: : 我们{i}切{/i}离 Chika 一会儿——双关是故意的——看起来 Noriko 也自带了刀！不过，我不太确定那玩意儿合不合规……

lines.en: : You never know when the knife strapped to your thigh will come in handy! And what I’ve learned after all these years of accidentally cutting myself with it is that it basically just never does. But that all ends today...
lines.zh: : 你永远不知道绑在大腿上的刀什么时候会派上用场！而这么多年不小心被它割到之后，我学到的就是：它基本上从来没派上过用场。不过今天这一切就要结束了……

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori17
: Now, a lesser chef would probably tell you that using a potato peeler to, you know, peel potatoes...is much easier, safer, and cuts back on food waste.
lines.zh: : 一个差一点的厨师大概会告诉你，用削皮器来，嗯，削土豆……要简单得多、安全得多，还能减少食物浪费。

lines.en: : But what they won’t tell you that a knife, for those who are experienced with them, is way more precise and helps easily carve out eyes like you see on this little guy here.
lines.zh: : 但他们不会告诉你的是，对用惯了刀的人来说，刀要精确得多，能轻松挖出这个小家伙身上那样的芽眼。

lines.en: : Didn’t you just say you never get to use yours, though?
lines.zh: : 可你刚刚不是说你从来没机会用你那把吗？

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori18
: I don’t get to use my {i}pocket knife.{/i} But that’s mostly just because my parents don’t let me when I help out with prep at the restaurant.
lines.zh: : 我是用不了我的{i}折叠刀{/i}。不过那主要是因为我在餐厅帮忙备菜时，我父母不让我用。

lines.en: : Think most of us forgot that was even a part of your character, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 我想我们大多数人大概都忘了这还是你人设的一部分，Noriko。

lines.en: : Well, maybe now you won’t! I’m actually a pretty good cook. And I would have won last year’s cooking contest too if it wasn’t for the fact that I love Yumi so much.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许现在你们不会忘了！我其实厨艺挺不错的。要不是因为我爱 Yumi 爱得那么深，去年的厨艺比赛我也能赢。

lines.en: : You know, you can always just {i}not{/i} do that.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你其实完全可以{i}不{/i}那样做。

lines.en: : Hi, Yumi! I love you!
lines.zh: : 你好，Yumi！我爱你！

lines.en: : Kaori, you got a bathroom over here by any chance? I wanna go work on my Futaba impression for a bit.
lines.zh: : Kaori，你这儿有洗手间吗？我想去练一会儿我的 Futaba 模仿秀。

lines.en: : You mean be really cute and wholesome and sneak away to read elf smut?
lines.zh: : 你是说装得又可爱又清纯，然后偷偷溜去看精灵色情小说？

lines.en: : Turn west around the next right angle to reach the room of bathing! Enjoy your elves.
lines.zh: : 在下一个直角处向西转，就能到达沐浴之室！好好享受你的精灵吧。

lines.en: : I don’t...ugh!
lines.zh: : 我才不……啊！

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori19
: I’ll just fuckin’ stand here and mind my own business. Ain’t like I can really take sides in the contest anyway.
lines.zh: : 我就他妈站在这儿管自己的事。反正这场比赛我也没法真的站哪一边。

lines.en: : Can you, like...not make fun of my friend when she’s not even here to defend herself, please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……别在我朋友都不在这儿、没法替自己辩解的时候嘲笑她，拜托？

lines.en: : Can you, like...fuck off and mind your own business?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……滚一边去管好你自己的事？

lines.en: : Can you {i}all{/i} like “shut up” while I’m trying to fucking {b}COOK?{/b}
lines.zh: : 你们{i}所有人{/i}能不能都「闭嘴」，我正他妈在{b}做菜{/b}呢？

lines.en: : On that note, Chika, what can you tell us about your dish today? What are you making, exactly?
lines.zh: : 说到这个，Chika，你能跟我们说说你今天的菜吗？你具体在做些什么？

lines.en: : {size=+20}{b}MEAT.{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=+20}{b}肉。{/b}{/size}

lines.en: : Where’d ya even find meat that size? Looks like it came off a friggin’ elephant.
lines.zh: : 你到底从哪儿找来那么大一坨肉？看着像是他妈从大象身上割下来的。

lines.en: : Did you murder an elephant, Chika? Is this the same animal you apparently tried to feed Rin in the place where we work? Are you {i}trying{/i} to get us closed down?
lines.zh: : 你杀了一头大象吗，Chika？这就是你据说在我们上班的地方试图喂给 Rin 吃的那只动物吗？你是{i}存心{/i}想让我们店关门吗？

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori20
: I don’t know what I’m doing anymore. Everything has seemed blurry for weeks now. And the only person who can save me is not here yet. When will she be here?
lines.zh: : 我已经不知道自己在做什么了。好几周以来一切都模糊不清。而唯一能救我的人还没到。她什么时候才来？

lines.en: : You’re talking about Niki, I presume?
lines.zh: : 你说的是 Niki 吧？

lines.en: : Girl.
lines.zh: : 女孩。

lines.en: : So you really ain’t at all bothered by the fact that she just randomly claimed Sensei as her property outta nowhere? Thought you loved {i}him{/i} or whatever?
lines.zh: : 所以她突然毫无征兆地宣称 Sensei 是她的所有物，你真的一点都不在意吗？我还以为你爱的是{i}他{/i}什么的？

lines.en: : I love both of them.
lines.zh: : 我两个都爱。

lines.en: : And you don’t feel betrayed by either one? Because Sensei’s one thing, but idols are supposed to remain pure, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 那你就没被她们任何一个背叛的感觉吗？Sensei 是一回事，可偶像不是应该保持纯洁的吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. And she’s been out here gettin’ raw-dogged by Sensei’s massive wiener since they were kids.
lines.zh: : 是啊。而她从小就被 Sensei 那根巨大的鸡巴无套操到大。

lines.en: : ‘Less it ain’t always been that big. But that’s even crazier because that means maybe she banged small-wiener Sensei and none of us ever even got that chance cause we weren’t born yet.
lines.zh: : 除非它以前没那么大。不过那样更疯狂，因为那意味着她可能上过小鸡巴版的 Sensei，而我们谁都没捞到那个机会，因为那时候我们还没出生。

lines.en: : Anything to add to that, Chika?
lines.zh: : 对此有什么要补充的吗，Chika？

lines.en: : Ask me again after I kill you.
lines.zh: : 等我杀了你之后再问我。

lines.en: : Noted.
lines.zh: : 记下了。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori21
: That just brings us over to Noriko, though! Who is significantly {i}less{/i} dangerous, much to the surprise of everyone who was very scared of her after she was introduced to the class!
lines.zh: : 那么接下来就是 Noriko 了！她的危险性可{i}低{/i}多了，这可让那些在她被介绍给全班之后还很怕她的人大跌眼镜！

lines.en: : {size=+10}{b}MEAT.{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=+10}{b}肉。{/b}{/size}

lines.en: : Are those {i}all{/i} vegetables over there? How the heck d’ya plan to make a variety of dishes without addin’ even a little protein?
lines.zh: : 那边{i}全{/i}是蔬菜吗？你到底打算怎么在一点蛋白质都不加的情况下做出好几道菜？

lines.en: : It’s not like vegetables don’t have {i}any{/i} protein, Miku. There are plenty of high-protein options outside of meat. Like chickpeas or spinach, for example. Or even corn as you’ll see soon.
lines.zh: : 蔬菜又不是{i}一点{/i}蛋白质都没有，Miku。除了肉之外，高蛋白的选择多得是。比如鹰嘴豆或者菠菜。甚至还有玉米，你马上就能看到。

lines.en: : So yes, while Chika’s {b}MEAT{/b} might beat out my spread in terms of protein alone, it’s combining all sorts of nutrients that helps keep us healthy and maintain apparently perfect bodies like mine.
lines.zh: : 所以没错，单论蛋白质，Chika 的{b}肉{/b}也许能赢过我这一桌菜，但正是各种营养素的组合，才让我们保持健康、维持像我这样显然完美的身材。

lines.en: : So you’re saying you’re not at all worried that your opponent has gone in the complete opposite direction with her cooking?
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，你一点也不担心你的对手在烹饪上走了完全相反的方向？

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori22
: Oh, not at all. It’s my goal today to show people that vegetarian food {i}can{/i} be appetizing and to subsequently break the stigma that we all survive off of avocado toast and veggie burgers.
lines.zh: : 哦，一点也不。我今天的目标就是向大家证明，素食{i}可以{/i}很好吃，并且顺带打破那种「我们全靠牛油果吐司和素汉堡维生」的刻板印象。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta say, Noriko, I’m not at all surprised by your determination! And I’d even go as far as saying this is the most {i}actual{/i} cooking we’ve had in a cooking contest so far!
lines.zh: : 我得说，Noriko，我对你的决心一点都不意外！我甚至敢说，这是到目前为止的厨艺比赛里最{i}像回事{/i}的一次烹饪！

lines.en: : Yeah, well, that’s just what happens when you pit two people against each other who can actually cook. And if Chika wasn’t so broken right now, I’m sure she’d be able to come up with something great too.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那也是没办法的事，毕竟你让两个真会做饭的人互相对决。要是 Chika 现在没这么崩坏，我敢肯定她也能做出很棒的东西。

lines.en: : Cooking for children might {i}seem{/i} easy, but kids can be some of the pickiest eaters out there. And I have a lot of respect for her and what she does for her sister on a daily basis.
lines.zh: : 给孩子做饭{i}看起来{/i}容易，但小孩子可能是世上最挑食的一群人。我很敬重她，也敬重她每天为妹妹做的那些事。

lines.en: : Then, let me ask you this — how many times have you had sex with Sensei so far?
lines.zh: : 那么，我想问你一句——到目前为止你跟 Sensei 上过几次床？

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori23
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : You heard her. We wanna know what we wanna know.
lines.zh: : 你听到了。我们想知道什么就想知道什么。

lines.en: : Is it more or less than Chika has?
lines.zh: : 比 Chika 多还是少？

lines.en: : Is this really relevant to the cooking competition?
lines.zh: : 这跟厨艺比赛真的有关系吗？

lines.en: : No, but Imani isn’t paying attention right now and nothing we say on TV ever has any sort of measurable consequences.
lines.zh: : 没有，可 Imani 现在没在注意，而且我们在电视上说的任何话都不会产生什么可衡量的后果。

lines.en: : Spill it, lady. How often’s he porkin’ ya and how come your sister ain’t got a problem with it?
lines.zh: : 快说，大姐。他多久干你一次，还有为什么你姐姐对此一点意见都没有？

lines.en: : Ch...Chika’s definitely done it with him more than I have. I’m still new to all of this, to be honest.
lines.zh: : Ch……Chika 跟他做的次数肯定比我多。老实说，我对这些还很生疏。

lines.en: : And your sister hasn’t entirely disowned you yet because?...
lines.zh: : 那你姐姐为什么还没跟你彻底断绝关系？……

lines.en: : Because she is broken beyond repair and incapable of envisioning a life without him. Can we go back to talking about food, please?
lines.zh: : 因为她已经坏得修不好了，根本无法想象没有他的生活。我们能回去聊食物了吗，拜托？

lines.en: : Nope. That’ll be all. Thank you, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 不行。就到这儿吧。谢谢你，Noriko。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori24
: Are you really making fuck to all of these girls, Friend? How have you not run out of human juice yet?
lines.zh: : 你真的在跟这些女孩全都做爱吗，朋友？你怎么还没把人类的汁液用光？

lines.en: : Not {i}all{/i} of them. Just...most.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}全部{/i}。只是……大部分。

lines.en: : This fills my body with feelings other than sex heat and makes me want to slap them with my human arm-feet.
lines.zh: : 这让我的身体里充满了性热以外的感情，还让我想用我的人类手脚去扇她们。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori25
: That’s probably jealousy, Kaori. You’re likely not far off from wanting to keep me to yourself too. It’s natural progression for girls like you who fall victim to my penis.
lines.zh: : 那大概是嫉妒，Kaori。你离想把我占为己有也不远了。对像你这样沦为我的鸡巴的受害者的女孩来说，这是自然的发展。

lines.en: : I am a victim of your penis? Have you been attempting to hurt me with it this whole time?
lines.zh: : 我是你的鸡巴的受害者？你这段时间一直在试图用它伤害我吗？

lines.en: : Maybe a little, sure. But mostly just for my own pleasure.
lines.zh: : 也许有一点吧，当然。但主要还是为了我自己爽。

lines.en: : Interesting. Because it hasn’t hurt at all.
lines.zh: : 有意思。因为一点都不痛啊。

lines.en: : Not even a little.
lines.zh: : 连一点都不。

lines.en: : Maybe if it was bigger, you would be able to injure me with it.
lines.zh: : 也许要是它再大一点，你就能用它伤到我了。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori26
: Are you {i}trying{/i} to get a rise out of me or is that just a side effect of your underlying obliviousness concerning all things sexual?
lines.zh: : 你是{i}存心{/i}想让我起反应，还是说这只是你对一切跟性有关的事都迟钝到骨子里的副作用？

lines.en: : It is rising? Right now?
lines.zh: : 它起来了？现在？

lines.en: : Yes, but not because I want it to.
lines.zh: : 是的，但不是因为我想让它起来。

lines.en: : The cotton candy girl told me I am no longer allowed to mate with you. But I am also not willing to say no to you if you want to because doing the sex makes me feel very good.
lines.zh: : 那个棉花糖女孩跟我说，我不能再跟你交配了。但如果你想要，我也不愿意拒绝你，因为做爱让我感觉非常好。

lines.en: : But maybe this is just my instincts causing me to crave impregnation so that we don’t die out as a species.
lines.zh: : 不过也许这只是我的本能在作祟，让我渴望受孕，好让我们这个物种不至于灭绝。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori27
: Silence your judgement, Nao-chan! It means nothing when you crave the same thing!
lines.zh: : 别评判了，Nao-chan！你明明也渴望同样的东西，那你的评判就毫无意义！

lines.en: : I’m just going to keep standing here because I feel like doing anything else will just get me in trouble.
lines.zh: : 我就继续站在这儿好了，因为我觉得做别的任何事都会让我惹上麻烦。

lines.en: scene black
The next forty minutes of waiting for the competition to end were painful, but not because they were slow.
lines.zh: 等待比赛结束的接下来四十分钟很痛苦，但不是因为时间过得慢。

lines.en: It’s because every minute is painful and I am not meant to be here.
lines.zh: 而是因为每一分钟都很痛苦，而我本就不该在这里。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori28
: W...Welcome back to food! We will now review...the food!
lines.zh: : 欢……欢迎回到食物！现在我们来评审……食物！

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori29
: Chicken Chosokabe! Please tell us about your dish!
lines.zh: : Chicken Chosokabe！请介绍一下你的菜！

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : {size=+40}{b}MEAT.{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=+40}{b}肉。{/b}{/size}

lines.en: : Did she just call you “Chicken Chosokabe?”
lines.zh: : 她刚刚是不是叫你「Chicken Chosokabe」？

lines.en: c" It’s my full name. "
lines.zh: c" 那是我的全名。 "

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori30
: Norman Nakayama!
lines.zh: : Norman Nakayama！

lines.en: : Hai! Norman desu.
lines.zh: : 是！我是 Norman。

lines.en: : Please provide foodular details. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 请提供食物方面的细节。谢谢。

lines.en: : Right! So, what we have here is an assortment of seasonal vegetables prepared two ways.
lines.zh: : 好的！那么，这里是一组用两种方式烹调的时令蔬菜。

lines.en: : The raw ones you see on the left were hand-picked based on beauty and freshness and cut into sticks that you may dip into fresh hummus you’ll find inside of the kabocha.
lines.zh: : 左边的那些生蔬菜是依据品相和新鲜度手工挑选的，切成了条，可以蘸着南瓜里装的新鲜鹰嘴豆泥吃。

lines.en: : The veggies on the right have been sautéed in sunflower oil and seasoned with just a little bit of salt and red pepper to bring out more of their natural flavor.
lines.zh: : 右边的蔬菜是用葵花籽油炒的，只加了一点盐和红辣椒调味，好带出它们更多的天然风味。

lines.en: : {size=-4}In addition to that, we have some grilled corn on the cob, coated and doused in garlic butter made with the help of local grass-fed, free-range cows who {i}also{/i} provided the milk used in the bean sprout chowder with chives you see above it!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}除此之外，我们还有烤玉米，裹满了蒜香黄油；这黄油来自当地草饲散养的奶牛，而它们{i}也{/i}提供了上面那道豆芽香葱浓汤里用到的牛奶！{/size}

lines.en: : And finally, to the right of that, we have white rice, tsukemono, and miso soup with wild mushrooms to serve as a palate cleanser between dishes.
lines.zh: : 最后，在它右边是白米饭、腌菜和野生菌味噌汤，用来在两道菜之间清口。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori31

: I wanted to make Chinese doughnuts and flourless chocolate cookies for dessert as well, but I ran out of time and decided it would be best to just tidy up the presentation of the veggie sticks instead.
lines.zh: : 我本来还想做中式甜甜圈和无面粉巧克力曲奇当甜点的，但时间不够了，我决定还是把蔬菜条的摆盘弄整齐更好。

lines.en: : Show-off.
lines.zh: : 爱现。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori32
: Huh?

: Right! So I have reviewed both dishes with Nao-chan and we have decided that Norman wins because her food tasted better, looked better, and did not involve the mindless slaughter of a protected species.
lines.zh: : 好的！我和 Nao-chan 评审了两道菜，我们决定由 Norman 获胜，因为她的食物更好吃、更好看，而且没有涉及对保护物种的盲目屠杀。

lines.en: : Those elephants died for nothing because of you, Noriko. I hope you’re happy.
lines.zh: : 那些大象因为你白死了，Noriko。我希望你满意了。

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori33
: I just wanted to show people that vegetables can be good too! Don’t pin this violence on me!
lines.zh: : 我只是想让大家知道蔬菜也可以很好吃！别把这暴力算到我头上！

lines.en: : I would have won if I cooked you.
lines.zh: : 如果我把你煮了，我早就赢了。

lines.en: : Yeah, because I wouldn’t have been able to compete!
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为那样我就没法参赛了！

lines.en: : Norman’s victory brings the score of this competition to...a tie! Each floor now has one point. But things are...just getting started! And our next competition raises the question of...what it means to be...family!
lines.zh: : Norman 的胜利让本次比赛的比分变成……平局！现在每层各有一分。不过一切才……刚刚开始！而我们的下一场比赛提出的问题是……家人意味着……什么！

lines.en: scene cookingwithkaori34
: Please join us at the Chicken’s house to find out...what happens next in the sixth annual...Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: : 敬请到鸡之家与我们会合，看看第六届……宿舍大战接下来会发生……什么！

lines.en: : Aaaaaand scene! Sponsors?!
lines.zh: : 好——收工！赞助商呢？！
